{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Exclude sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
valid_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline_severe = valid_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_baseline_severe"}
